decisions.title: Padres denuncian atraso en construcción de domo escolar en Ecoterra, Puerto Vallarta
decisions.note: Parents report the school dome works in fraccionamiento Ecoterra are still unfinished after classes resumed; the court stays fenced and out of service. A stalled public works project affecting residents.
